# Offline synthetic direction-review fixtures

Every source is fabricated for contract tests. None establishes scientific
adequacy, real permission, a selected direction, runtime spending, or execution
authorization. Evidence paths resolve under this directory; SHA-256 values bind
the exact committed raw bytes. Candidate hashes use full UTF-8 JSON with sorted
keys, compact separators, and ensure_ascii=False, independently of production.

The v1 dossier contains G1 (annual question) and G2 (monthly question). All seven
prerequisite kinds are present, and G2 has two independently named data checks.
Unknown license/effect checks have bounded next checks; the monthly-data claim
is supplied as contradicted. Person-week estimates are 7 + 8 against 10.
The note source is explicitly a summary, not original full text.

Tests derive adversarial revisions from these fixtures in temporary copies.
The pre-existing topic_dossier_sample.gaps.yml remains the legacy fixture
without candidate_version. No model, private dataset, account, or network is
required.
